descEn:
Automatically group rooms with similar properties and use the groups to assign zones.
_
Relevant properties that are used to group Room2Ds into zones include story,
orientation, and (optionally) energy programs.
_
Rooms that share the same zone have a common thermostat in energy simulation.
This can often significnatly reduce simulation time without greatly impacting
energy use results.

in.d: A list of honeybee honeybee Rooms to which zones will be assigned. This can also be an entire Honeybee Model. Note that these rooms should have adjacencies solved in order for them to be correctly zoned based on orientation.

A positive integer to set the number of orientation groups to use for zoning. For example, setting this to 4 will result in zones being established based on the four orientations (North, East, South, West). (Default: 8).
A number between 0 and 360 to set the clockwise north direction in degrees. This can also be a vector to set the North. Default is 0 for the world Y-axis.
Boolean for whether the Programs assigned to the Rooms should be ignored during the automatic zoning process in which case rooms with different programs can appear in the same zone. (Default: False).

out.d: Errors, warnings, etc.
The input Rooms (or Model) with zones assigned based on the input criteria.

name: HB Custom Ground
desc: 替换模型默认地面，用于坡地或非平整场地。
descEn:
Set the boundary conditions of Rooms to be Ground vs. Outdoors using a surface or
polysurface that represents the ground.
_
Room faces that are coplanar with the ground surface or have a center below it
will get a Ground boundary condition. Existing Faces with a Surface/Adiabatic
condition, AirBoundary type, or assigned Apertures/Doors will be unaffected.
_
Note that this component will not intersect the Faces with the ground surface and
this is intersection should be done prior to the creation of the Honeybee Rooms.

in.d: Honeybee Rooms which will have their Face boundary conditions set based on their spatial relation to the _ground geometry below.
Rhino Breps or Meshes that represent the Ground.

A Boolean to note whether the _ground geometry simply adds additional ground boundary conditions to the _rooms (False) or it resets all existing ground boundary conditions to only exist at or below the _ground geometry (True). (Default: False).

out.d: The input Rooms with their Ground boundary conditions set.

name: HB Deconstruct Model
desc: 把 Honeybee 模型拆成房间、面、窗洞、遮阳等列表，便于分别处理。
descEn: Deconstruct a Honeybee Model object into all of its constituent Honeybee objects.

in.d: A Honeybee Model to be deconstructed into into its constituent objects (Rooms, Faces, Apertures, Doors Shades).

out.d: All of the Room objects contained within the input Model.
All of the orphaned Face objects within the input Model. This only oncludes parent-less Faces and does not include any Faces that belong to a Room.
All of the orphaned Aperture objects within the input Model. This only oncludes parent-less Apertures and does not include any Apertures that belong to a Face.
All of the orphaned Door objects within the input Model. This only oncludes parent-less Doors and does not include any Doors that belong to a Face.
All of the orphaned Shade objects within the input Model. This only oncludes parent-less Shades and does not include any Shades that belong to an Aperture, Face, or Room.

name: HB Deconstruct Object
desc: 把任意 Honeybee 对象拆成几何、标识符与属性字段。
descEn:
Deconstruct any Honeybee geometry object into all of its constituent Honeybee objects.
_
This is useful for editing auto-generated child objects separately from their parent.
For example, if you want to move all of the overhangs that were auto-generated for
a Room downward in order to turn them into light shelves, this component can give
you all of such shades. Then you can move the shades and assign them back to the
original shade-less Room object.

in.d: A Honeybee Room, Face, Aperture, Door or Shade to be deconstructed into its constituent objects. Note that, Doors and Shades do not have sub-objects assigned to them and the original object will be output.

out.d: All of the Face objects that make up the input _hb_obj. This includes Faces that make up input Rooms as well as any input orphaned Faces.
All of the Aperture objects that make up the input _hb_obj. This includes any Apertures assigned to input Rooms or Faces as well as any input orphaned Apertures.
All of the Door objects that make up the input _hb_obj. This includes any Doors assigned to input Rooms or Faces as well as any input orphaned Doors.
All of the Shade objects that make up the input _hb_obj. This includes any Shades assigned to input Rooms, Faces or Apertures as well as any input orphaned Shades.

name: HB Door
desc: 在 Honeybee 面上创建门（Door），可设置玻璃门或实体门及其构造。
descEn: Create Honeybee Door

in.d: Rhino Brep or Mesh geometry.
A name for the Door. If the name is not provided a random name will be assigned.
Boolean to note whether the Door is transparent. Default: False.

Optional text for the Door's energy construction to be looked up in the construction library. This can also be a custom construction object. If no energy construction is input here, a default will be assigned based on the properties of the parent face that the Door is assigned to (ie. whether the Face is a RoofCeiling, whether it has a Surface boundary condition, etc.)

Optional text for the Door's radiance modifier to be looked up in the modifier library. This can also be a custom modifier object. If no radiance modifier is input here, a default will be assigned based on the properties of the parent face that the Door is assigned to (ie. whether the Face is a RoofCeiling, whether it has a Surface boundary condition, etc.)

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
Honeybee doors. These can be used directly in radiance simulations or can be added to a Honeybee face for energy simulation.

name: HB Extruded Border Shades
desc: 沿窗洞边框向外挤出遮阳板，可分别设置上下左右挑出深度。
descEn:
Add extruded border Shades to all the outdoor Apertures of an input Room, Face
or Aperture.
_
This is particularly useful for accounting for the depths of walls/roofs in Radiance
simulations or in the solar distribution calculation of EnergyPlus.

in.d: A list of honeybee Rooms, Faces, or Apertures to which extruded border shades will be added.
A number for the extrusion depth. If an array of values are input here, different depths will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise.

Boolean for whether the extrusion should be generated facing the opposite direction of the aperture normal and added to the Aperture's indoor_shades instead of outdoor_shades. If an array of values are input here, different indoor booleans will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise. Note that indoor shades are not used in energy simulations but they are used in all simulations involving Radiance. (Default: False).

Optional Honeybee ShadeConstruction to be applied to the input _hb_objs. This can also be text for a construction to be looked up in the shade construction library. If an array of text or construction objects are input here, different constructions will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise.

Optional Honeybee Modifier to be applied to the input _hb_objs. This can also be text for a modifier to be looked up in the shade modifier library. If an array of text or modifier objects are input here, different modifiers will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
The input Honeybee Face or Room or Aperture with extruded border shades added to it.

name: HB Facade Parameters
desc: 定义立面的层高、窗墙比、凹凸等参数，供批量生成建筑表皮使用。
descEn:
Generate lists of facadce properties ordanized by the four primary cardinal
directions.
_
Such properties can be glazing ratios, glazing heigths, sill heights, horizontal/
vertical glazing splits for the "HB Apertures by Ratio" component. Or they could
be shade depths, angles, etc. for the "HB Louver Shades" component.

in.d: Glazing parameter (boolean, float) for the north.
Glazing parameter (boolean, float) for the east.
Glazing parameter (boolean, float) for the south.
Glazing parameter (boolean, float) for the west.

out.d: A list of properties for different cardinal directions to be plugged into the "HB Apertures by Ratio" component or the "HB Louver Shades" component.

name: HB Face
desc: 由 Rhino 面创建 Honeybee 面（Face），并指定边界条件（室外、地表、表面）与面类型。
descEn: Create Honeybee Face

in.d: Rhino Brep or Mesh geometry.
Text to set the name for the Face and to be incorporated into unique Face identifier. If the name is not provided, a random name will be assigned.

Text for the face type. The face type will be used to set the material and construction for the surface if they are not assigned through the inputs below. The default is automatically set based on the normal direction of the Face (up being RoofCeiling, down being Floor and vertically-oriented being Wall). Choose from the following: - Wall - RoofCeiling - Floor - AirBoundary

Text for the boundary condition of the face. The boundary condition is also used to assign default materials and constructions as well as the nature of heat excahnge across the face in energy simulation. Default is Outdoors unless all vertices of the geometry lie below the below the XY plane, in which case it will be set to Ground. Choose from the following: - Outdoors - Ground - Adiabatic

Optional text for the Face's energy construction to be looked up in the construction library. This can also be a custom OpaqueConstruction object. If no energy construction is input here, the face type and boundary condition will be used to assign a default.

Optional text for the Face's radiance modifier to be looked up in the modifier library. This can also be a custom modifier object. If no radiance modifier is input here, the face type and boundary condition will be used to assign a default.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
Honeybee faces. These can be used directly in radiance simulations or can be added to a Honeybee room for energy simulation.

name: HB Intersect Solids
desc: 把多个实体相互切割并求交，消除重叠体量，得到干净的房间几何。
descEn:
Take a list of Honeybee Rooms closed breps (polysurfaces) and split their Faces
to ensure that there are matching coplanar faces between them.
_
This matching between Room faces is required in order to contruct a correct
multi-room energy model since conductive heat flow won't occur correctly across
interior faces when their surface areas do not match.

in.d: A list of Honeybee Rooms or closed Rhino breps (polysurfaces) that do not have matching adjacent Faces.

An integer to set the number of CPUs used in the execution of the intersection calculation. If unspecified, it will automatically default to one less than the number of CPUs currently available on the machine or 1 if only one processor is available.
Set to True to run the component.

out.d: The same input Rooms or closed breps that have had their component faces split by adjacent geometries to have matching surfaces.

name: HB Louver Shades
desc: 在窗洞外侧按数量、角度与深度生成百叶遮阳构件。
descEn:
Add louverd Shades, overhangs or fins to all the outdoor Apertures of an input
Room, Face or Aperture.
_
Note that, if a Face or Room is input, Shades will only be added to those Faces
that are Walls (not Floors or Roofs).

in.d: A list of honeybee Rooms, Faces, or Apertures to which louver shades will be added.
A number for the depth to extrude the louvers. If an array of values are input here, different depths will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise.

A positive integer for the number of louvers to generate. If there is an input below for _dist_between_, an attempt will still be made to meet the _shade_count_ but, if there are more shades than can fit on the input hb_obj, the number of shades will be truncated. If an array of values are input here, different shade counts will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise. (Default: 1).

A number for the approximate distance between each louver. If an array of values are input here, different distances between louvers will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise.

A number for the distance from the louver edge to the facade. If an array of values are input here, different offsets will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise. (Default: 0).

A number for the for an angle to rotate the louvers in degrees. If an array of values are input here, different angles will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise. (Default: 0).

Optional boolean to note whether the lovers are vertical. If False, the louvers will be horizontal. If an array of values are input here, different vertical booleans will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise. (Default: False).

Optional boolean to note whether the side the louvers start from should be flipped. If False, louvers will be generated starting on top or the right side. If True, louvers will start from the bottom or left. If an array of values are input here, different flip start booleans will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise. Default: False.

Optional boolean for whether louvers should be generated facing the opposite direction of the aperture normal and added to the Aperture's indoor_shades instead of outdoor_shades. If an array of values are input here, different indoor booleans will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise. Note that, by default, indoor shades are not used in energy simulations but they are used in all simulations involving Radiance. (Default: False).

Optional Honeybee ShadeConstruction to be applied to the input _hb_objs. This can also be text for a construction to be looked up in the shade construction library. If an array of text or construction objects are input here, different constructions will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise.
Optional schedule for the transmittance to be applied to the input _hb_objs in energy simulation. If no energy schedule is input here, the default will be always opaque.

Optional Honeybee Modifier to be applied to the input _hb_objs. This can also be text for a modifier to be looked up in the shade modifier library. If an array of text or modifier objects are input here, different modifiers will be assigned based on cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
The input Honeybee Face or Room or Aperture with louvered shades added to it.

name: HB Mirror
desc: 按镜面镜像 Honeybee 对象，生成对称体量。
descEn: Mirror any Honeybee geometry object or a Model across a plane.

in.d: Any Honeybee geometry object (eg. Room, Face, Aperture, Door or Shade) to be mirrored across a plane. This can also be a Honeybee Model object to be mirrored.
A Plane across which the object will be mirrored.

Optional text string that will be inserted at the start of the identifiers and display names of all transformed objects, their child objects, and their adjacent Surface boundary condition objects. This is particularly useful in workflows where you duplicate and edit a starting object and then want to combine it with the original object into one Model (like making a model of repeated rooms) since all objects within a Model must have unique identifiers. It is recommended that this prefix be short to avoid maxing out the 100 allowable characters for honeybee identifiers. If None, no prefix will be added to the input objects and all identifiers and display names will remain the same. Default: None.

out.d: The input _hb_objs that has been mirrored across the input plane.

name: HB Model
desc: 把房间、遮阳、构造集、运行计划等汇总为 Honeybee 模型，是导出与模拟的总入口。
descEn: Create a Honeybee Model, which can be sent for simulation.

in.d: A list of honeybee Rooms to be added to the Model. Note that at least one Room is necessary to make a simulate-able energy model.
A list of honeybee Faces to be added to the Model. Note that faces without a parent Room are not allowed for energy models.
A list of honeybee Shades or ShadeMeshes to be added to the Model.
A list of honeybee Apertures to be added to the Model. Note that apertures without a parent Face are not allowed for energy models.
A list of honeybee Doors to be added to the Model. Note that doors without a parent Face are not allowed for energy models.
Text to be used for the Model name and to be incorporated into a unique model identifier. If no name is provided, it will be "unnamed" and a unique model identifier will be auto-generated.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
A Honeybee Model object possessing all of the input geometry objects.

name: HB Move
desc: 按矢量平移 Honeybee 对象，几何与属性一起移动。
descEn: Move any Honeybee geometry object or a Model object along a vector.

in.d: Any Honeybee geometry object (eg. Room, Face, Aperture, Door or Shade) to be moved along the input vector. This can also be a Honeybee Model object to be moved.
A Vector3D with the direction and distance to move the _hb_objs.

Optional text string that will be inserted at the start of the identifiers and display names of all transformed objects, their child objects, and their adjacent Surface boundary condition objects. This is particularly useful in workflows where you duplicate and edit a starting object and then want to combine it with the original object into one Model (like making a model of repeated rooms) since all objects within a Model must have unique identifiers. It is recommended that this prefix be short to avoid maxing out the 100 allowable characters for honeybee identifiers. If None, no prefix will be added to the input objects and all identifiers and display names will remain the same. Default: None.

out.d: The input _hb_objs that has been moved along the input vector.

name: HB Offset Aperture Edges
desc: 把窗洞边缘向内或向外偏移，用于调整窗框宽度与有效采光面积。
descEn:
Offset the edges of all Apertures of a Honeybee Room or Face by a certain distance.
_
This is useful for translating between interfaces that expect the window
frame to be included within or excluded from the geometry of the Aperture.
For example, EnergyPlus expects Aperture geometry to be for only the glass
portion of the window while IES-VE expects the Aperture geometry to include
the frame.
_
Note that this component also has usefulness to simply repair cases where
Apertures extend pas their parent Face or overlap with one another. In this
situation, the offset input can be set to zero and the repair_ boolean set to
True to only run the repair operation.

in.d: A list of honeybee Rooms or Faces for which Apertures will have their edges offset. This can also be an entire honeybee Model for which all Rooms will have Apertures offset.

A number for the distance with which the edges of each Aperture will be offset from the original geometry. Positive values will offset the geometry outwards and negative values will offset the geometries inwards.

A bool to note whether invalid Apertures and Doors should be fixed after performing the initial offset operation. This repair process involves two steps. First, sub-faces that extend past their parent Face are trimmed with the parent and will have their edges offset towards the inside of the Face. Second, any sub-faces that overlap or touch one another will be unioned into a single Aperture or Door. (Default: False).

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
The input Honeybee Face, Room or Model with Apertures offset.

name: HB Planarize Brep
desc: 把带曲率的曲面细分为近似平面，满足 EnergyPlus 对平面面的要求。
descEn:
Planarize Rhino breps in a manner that allows control over the meshing process.
_
The resulting planar breps will be solid if the input brep is solid and any
planar faces of the brep will remain unchanged except for the polygonization
of curved edges.

in.d: A list of closed Rhino polysurfaces (aka. breps) to be planarized.

Optional Rhino Meshing Parameters to describe how curved faces should be convereted into planar elements. These can be obtained from the native Grasshopper mesh Settings components. If None, Rhino's Default Meshing Parameters will be used, which tend to be very coarse and simple.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
A planar version of the input _brep.

name: HB Properties by Guide Surface
desc: 把导向面上的属性（构造、边界条件等）批量传递给目标面。
descEn:
Set the properties of room Faces using (a) guide surface(s) or polysurface(s).
_
Faces that are touching and coplanar with the guide surface will get their
properties changed to match the inputs.
_
This is useful for colelctively setting the properties of spatially aligned Faces,
like setting Faces along a given stretch of a parti wall to be adiabatic.

in.d: Honeybee Rooms which will have their Face boundary conditions set based on the guide surface(s).
Rhino Breps or Meshes that represent the guide surfaces.

Text for the face type. The face type will be used to set the material and construction for the surface if they are not assigned through the inputs below. Choose from the following: - Wall - RoofCeiling - Floor - AirBoundary

Text for the boundary condition of the face. The boundary condition is also used to assign default materials and constructions as well as the nature of heat excahnge across the face in energy simulation. Choose from the following: - Outdoors - Ground - Adiabatic
Optional text for the Face's energy construction to be looked up in the construction library. This can also be a custom OpaqueConstruction object.
Optional text for the Face's radiance modifier to be looked up in the modifier library. This can also be a custom modifier object.

out.d: The input Rooms with their Face properties changed.

name: HB Recipe Settings
desc: 设置采光与辐射配方（Recipe）的通用参数，如引擎、并行数与输出项。
descEn:
Specify settings for the run of a recipe, including the number of workers/CPUs,
the project folder, and other settings.

in.d: Path to a project folder in which the recipe will be executed. If None, the default project folder for the Recipe will be used.

An integer to set the number of CPUs used in the execution of the recipe. This number should not exceed the number of CPUs on the machine and should be lower if other tasks are running while the simulation is running. If unspecified, it will automatically default to one less than the number of CPUs currently available on the machine. (Default: None)

A boolean to indicate whether existing results for a given model and recipe should be reloaded (if they are found) instead of re-running the entire recipe from the beginning. If False or None, any existing results will be overwritten by the new simulation.
An optional path to a debug folder. If debug folder is provided, all the steps of the simulation will be executed inside the debug folder which can be used for further inspection.

out.d: Recipe settings that can be plugged into any recipe component to specify how the simulation should be run.

name: HB Room
desc: 由若干 Honeybee 面（Face）围合成封闭房间（Room），是能量与采光模拟的基本空间单元，可附带名称、构造集、运行计划等属性。
descEn:
Create Honeybee Room from Honeybee Faces.
_
Note that each Room is mapped to a single zone in EnergyPlus/OpenStudio and
should always be a closed volume to ensure correct volumetric calculations and
avoid light leaks in Radiance simulations.

in.d: A list of honeybee Faces to be joined together into a Room.
Text to set the name for the Room and to be incorporated into unique Room identifier. If the name is not provided, a random name will be assigned.

Text for the modifier set of the Room, which is used to assign all default radiance modifiers needed to create a radiance model. Text should refer to a ModifierSet within the library) such as that output from the "HB List Modifier Sets" component. This can also be a custom ModifierSet object. If nothing is input here, the Room will have a generic construction set that is not sensitive to the Room's climate or building energy code.

Text for the construction set of the Room, which is used to assign all default energy constructions needed to create an energy model. Text should refer to a ConstructionSet within the library) such as that output from the "HB List Construction Sets" component. This can also be a custom ConstructionSet object. If nothing is input here, the Room will have a generic construction set that is not sensitive to the Room's climate or building energy code.

Text for the program of the Room (to be looked up in the ProgramType library) such as that output from the "HB List Programs" component. This can also be a custom ProgramType object. If no program is input here, the Room will have a generic office program. Note that ProgramTypes effectively map to OpenStudio space types upon export to OpenStudio.
Boolean to note whether the Room has a heating and cooling system.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
Honeybee room. These can be used directly in energy and radiance simulations.

name: HB Room from Solid
desc: 把 Rhino 的封闭实体（Brep/Polysurface）直接转换为 Honeybee 房间，自动识别地面、屋面和墙面。
descEn:
Create Honeybee Rooms from solids (closed Rhino polysurfaces).
_
Note that each Room is mapped to a single zone in EnergyPlus/OpenStudio and
should always be a closed volume to ensure correct volumetric calculations and
avoid light leaks in Radiance simulations.

in.d: A list of closed Rhino polysurfaces (aka.breps) to be converted into honeybee Rooms. This list can also include closed meshes that represent the rooms.
Text to set the base name for the Room, which will also be incorporated into unique Room identifier. If the name is not provided, a random name will be assigned.

Text for the modifier set of the Rooms, which is used to assign all default radiance modifiers needed to create a radiance model. Text should refer to a ModifierSet within the library) such as that output from the "HB List Modifier Sets" component. This can also be a custom ModifierSet object. If nothing is input here, the Room will have a generic construction set that is not sensitive to the Room's climate or building energy code.

Text for the construction set of the Rooms, which is used to assign all default energy constructions needed to create an energy model. Text should refer to a ConstructionSet within the library such as that output from the "HB List Construction Sets" component. This can also be a custom ConstructionSet object. If nothing is input here, the Rooms will have a generic construction set that is not sensitive to the Rooms's climate or building energy code.

Text for the program of the Rooms (to be looked up in the ProgramType library) such as that output from the "HB List Programs" component. This can also be a custom ProgramType object. If no program is input here, the Rooms will have a generic office program. Note that ProgramTypes effectively map to OpenStudio space types upon export to OpenStudio.
Boolean to note whether the Rooms have heating and cooling systems.

A number between 0 and 90 to set the angle from the horizontal plane below which faces will be considered roofs or floors instead of walls. 90 indicates that all vertical faces are roofs and 0 indicates that all horizontal faces are walls. The default value of 60 degrees is the recommended value given by the ASHRAE 90.1 standard. (Default: 60).

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
Honeybee rooms. These can be used directly in energy and radiance simulations.

name: HB Rotate
desc: 绕指定轴旋转 Honeybee 对象，用于朝向对比与体量调整。
descEn: Rotate any Honeybee geometry object or a Model by an angle.

in.d: Any Honeybee geometry object (eg. Room, Face, Aperture, Door or Shade) to be rotated by an angle. This can also be a Honeybee Model object to be rotated.
An angle for rotation in degrees.

A Point3D for the origin around which the object will be rotated. If None,  it will be rotated from each object's center point unless the input object is a Model, in which case, it will be rotated from the world origin (0, 0, 0).
A Vector3D axis representing the axis of rotation. If None, the axis will be a Z-vector (0, 0, 1) and the object will be rotated within the XY plane.

Optional text string that will be inserted at the start of the identifiers and display names of all transformed objects, their child objects, and their adjacent Surface boundary condition objects. This is particularly useful in workflows where you duplicate and edit a starting object and then want to combine it with the original object into one Model (like making a model of repeated rooms) since all objects within a Model must have unique identifiers. It is recommended that this prefix be short to avoid maxing out the 100 allowable characters for honeybee identifiers. If None, no prefix will be added to the input objects and all identifiers and display names will remain the same. Default: None.

out.d: The input _hb_objs that has been rotated by the input angle.

name: HB Scale
desc: 按比例缩放 Honeybee 对象。
descEn: Scale any Honeybee geometry object or a Model by a factor.

in.d: Any Honeybee geometry object (eg. Room, Face, Aperture, Door or Shade) to be scaled by a factor. This can also be a Honeybee Model object to be scaled.
A number representing how much the object should be scaled.

A Point3D representing the origin from which to scale. If None, it will be scaled from each object's center point unless the input object is a Model, in which case, it will be scaled from the world origin (0, 0, 0).

Optional text string that will be inserted at the start of the identifiers and display names of all transformed objects, their child objects, and their adjacent Surface boundary condition objects. This is particularly useful in workflows where you duplicate and edit a starting object and then want to combine it with the original object into one Model (like making a model of repeated rooms) since all objects within a Model must have unique identifiers. It is recommended that this prefix be short to avoid maxing out the 100 allowable characters for honeybee identifiers. If None, no prefix will be added to the input objects and all identifiers and display names will remain the same. Default: None.

out.d: The input _hb_objs that has been scaled by the input factor.

name: HB Set Identifier
desc: 为对象设置唯一标识符，避免模拟时出现重名冲突。
descEn:
THIS COMPONENT IS INTENDED FOR ADVANCED USERS WHO UNDERSTAND THAT IDENTIFERS
SHOULD BE UNIQUE AND THAT, TO SET THEM OTHERWISE CAN HAVE UNINTENDED CONSEQUENCES.
_
Change the identifier of any Honeybee object.
_
Note that this component only changes the identifer of the input _hb_obj and
none of the identifiers of the child objects.

in.d: Any honeybee-core object (eg. Room, Face, Shade, Aperture) or any honeybee extension object (eg. energy construction, radiance modifier) for which the identifier should be changed.

Text for the identifier of the object. Note that, if this identifier does not conform to acceptable values of the object type (eg. no spaces for a radiance modifier id), then an exception will be thrown.
An optional text string to set the name of the object to something other than the identifier.

out.d: The input Honeybee object with its identifier changed.

name: HB Set Multiplier
desc: 为房间设置重复倍数，用一个代表房间代替多个相同房间，减少计算量。
descEn:
Change the multiplier of a honeybee Room.
_
Multipliers are used to speed up the calculation when similar Rooms are
repeated more than once. Essentially, a given simulation with the
Room is run once and then the result is multiplied by the multiplier.
This means that the "repetition" isn't in a particular direction (it's
essentially in the exact same location) and this comes with some
inaccuracy. However, this error might not be too large if the Rooms
are similar enough and it can often be worth it since it can greatly
speed up the calculation.

in.d: Honeybee Rooms to which the input _multipier should be assigned.
An integer noting how many times the Rooms are repeated. This can also be an array of integers, which align with the input _rooms and will be matched to them accordingly.

Boolean to indicate whether the floor area of the room is excluded from the Model it is a part of. Note that this will not affect the floor_area property of this Room but it will ensure the Room's floor area is excluded from any calculations when the Room is part of a Model and when it is simulated in EnergyPlus.

out.d: The input Rooms with their multipliers edited.

name: HB Set Story
desc: 标记房间所属楼层，用于楼层统计、模型分层显示与多楼层分析。
descEn:
Set text for the story identifier for honeybee Rooms.
_
Rooms sharing the same story identifier are considered part of the same story
in a Model.

in.d: Honeybee Rooms to which the input _story should be assigned.
Text for the story identifier to which the rooms belong.

out.d: The input Rooms with their stories set.

name: HB Set Zone
desc: 把房间指定到某个热区（Zone），多个房间可共用一个热区参与能量计算。
descEn:
Set text for the zone identifier for honeybee Rooms.
_
Rooms sharing the same zone identifier are considered part of the same zone
in a Model. If a zone identifier has not been specified for a given Room, it
will be the same as the Room identifier.

in.d: Honeybee Rooms to which the input _zone identifier should be assigned.
Text for the zone identifier to which the rooms belong.

out.d: The input Rooms with their zones set.

name: HB Shade
desc: 由 Rhino 几何创建遮阳面（Shade），不参与热工围护，只参与遮阳与辐射计算。
descEn: Create Honeybee Shade.

in.d: Rhino Brep or Mesh geometry.
Text to set the name for the Shade and to be incorporated into unique Shade identifier. If the name is not provided, a random name will be assigned.

Boolean to note whether the Shade is attached to other geometry. This is automatically set to True if the Shade is assigned to a parent Room, Face, Aperture or Door but will otherwise defalt to False. If the Shade is not easily assignable to a parent object but is attached to the building (eg. a parapet or large roof overhang), then this should be set to True. (Default: False).

Optional text for the Shade's energy construction to be looked up in the construction library. This can also be a custom construction object. If no energy construction is input here, a default will be assigned.

Optional text for the Shade's energy transmittance schedule to be looked up in the schedule library. This can also be a custom schedule object. If no energy schedule is input here, the default will be always opaque.
Optional text for the Shade's radiance modifier to be looked up in the modifier library. This can also be a custom modifier object. If no radiance modifier is input here, a default will be assigned.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
Honeybee shades. These can be used directly in radiance and energy simulations.

name: HB Simplify Apertures
desc: 把形状复杂的窗洞合并简化为矩形窗，减少模型复杂度与计算量。
descEn:
Simplify the Apertures assigned to Honeybee Rooms or Faces to be as few as
possible while still maintaining approximately the same overall Aperture area.
_
By default, this component will only simplify Apertures in convex Faces by 
reducing them to a ratio represented with one or two clean Apertures.
For models without many concave Faces, this process usually produces a
fast-simulating result that matches the original window area exactly. However,
this operation will also change the placement of Apertures within a Face,
which may make it unsuitable for modeling the impact of Shades on Apertures
or for evaluating daylight.
_
For cases with concave Faces (which is typical for Roofs/Skylights) or when it
is desirable to keep Apertures in the same location within the parent Face,
the Apertures can be simplified by specifying a merge_dist_, which will join
together Apertures in close proximity to one another rather than reducing
them to a ratio.

in.d: A list of honeybee Rooms or Faces to which Apertures will be simplified. This can also be an entire honeybee Model for which all Rooms will have Apertures simplified.

Distance between Apertures and/or Doors at which point they will be merged into a single Aperture. When unspecified, only Apertures within convex faces will be reduced to a ratio. This will match the original Aperture area exactly but it will change the placement of Apertures within the Face, which can make it unsuitable for modeling the impact of Shades on Apertures. When a value is specified here, concave Faces will be addressed and Apertures will remain where they are in the parent Face. The overall Aperture area may be a little larger thanks to merging across gaps that are less than or equal to the value specified but the result will be suitable for evaluating the impact of Shades or simulating daylight.

Boolean to note whether the simplification process should remove all interior Apertures with a Surface boundary condition (True) or an attempt will be made to reset adjacencies after Apertures have been simplified/rebuilt (False). (Default: False).
Boolean to note whether the simplification process should ignore all skylights and leave them as they are. (Default: False).
Boolean to note whether the simplification process should ignore all windows and leave them as they are. (Default: False).

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
The input Honeybee Face, Room or Model with Apertures simplified.

name: HB Skylights by Ratio
desc: 按屋面积比例在屋顶自动生成天窗，用于采光与得热平衡研究。
descEn:
Add skylight apertures to a Honeybee Face or Room given a ratio of aperture area
to face area.
_
Note that this component will only add Apertures to Faces that are Roofs and have
an Outdoors boundary condition.

in.d: A list of honeybee Rooms or Faces to which skylight Apertures will be added based on the inputs.
A number between 0 and 1 for the ratio between the area of the apertures and the area of the parent face.
The x dimension of the grid cells as a number. (Default: 3 meters)
The y dimension of the grid cells as a number. Default is None, which will assume the same cell dimension for y as is set for x.
An optional boolean to note whether the generated Apertures can be opened for ventilation. Default: False.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
The input Honeybee Face or Room with skylight Apertures generated from the input parameters.

name: HB Solve Adjacency
desc: 自动识别共面的房间面并建立相邻关系，消除重复外墙，保证能量模型正确。
descEn:
Solve adjacencies between a series of honeybee Rooms.
_
Note that rooms must have matching faces in order for them to be discovered as
adjacent.

in.d: A list of honeybee Rooms for which adjacencies will be solved.

Optional construction subset list from the "HB Interior Construction Subset" component. This will be used to assign custom constructions for the adjacent Faces, Apertures, and Doors found in the process of solving adjacency. Note that None values in the input list correspond to constructions that will not change from the default. If no value is input here, the default interior constructions will be assigned using the adjacent Rooms' ConstructionSet.

Optional Radiance modifier subset list from the "HB Interior Material Subset" component. This will be used to assign custom radiance modifiers for the adjacent Faces, Apertures, and Doors found in the process of solving adjacency. Note that None values in the input list correspond to modifiers that will not change from the default. If no value is input here, the default interior modifiers will be assigned using the adjacent Rooms' ModifierSet.

Set to True to have all of the adjacencies discovered by this component set to an adiabatic boundary condition. If False, a Surface boundary condition will be used for all adjacencies. Note that adabatic conditions are not allowed if interior windows are assigned to interior faces. Default: False.

Set to True to have all of the face adjacencies discovered by this component set to an AirBoundary face type. Note that AirBoundary face types are not allowed if interior windows are assigned to interior faces. Default: False.
Boolean to note whether existing Surface boundary conditions should be overwritten. If False or None, only newly-assigned adjacencies will be updated.
Set to True to run the component and solve adjacencies.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
The input Honeybee Rooms with adjacencies solved between matching Faces.

name: HB Straight Skeleton
desc: 用直骨架算法把不规则平面剖分为规则房间，常用于住宅与办公单元划分。
descEn:
Get the straight skeleton and core/perimeter sub-faces for any planar geometry.
_
This component uses a modified version of the the polyskel package
(https://github.com/Botffy/polyskel) by Armin Scipiades (aka. @Bottfy),
which is, itself, a Python implementation of the straight skeleton
algorithm as described by Felkel and Obdrzalek in their 1998 conference paper
Straight skeleton implementation
(https://github.com/Botffy/polyskel/blob/master/doc/StraightSkeletonImplementation.pdf).

in.d: Horizontal Rhino surfaces for which the straight skeleton will be computed.

An optional positive number that will be used to offset the perimeter of the geometry to output core/perimeter polygons. If a value is plugged in here and the straight skeleton is not self-intersecting, perim_poly and core_poly will be ouput.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
A list of line segments that represent the straight skeleton of the input _floor_geo. This will be output from the component no matter what the input _floor_geo is.
A list of breps representing the perimeter polygons of the input _floor_geo. This will only be ouput if an offset_ is input.
A list of breps representing the core polygons of the input _floor_geo. This will only be ouput if an offset_ is input and the offset is not so great as to eliminate the core.

name: HB Visualize Recipe Execution
desc: 显示配方执行过程与中间产物，用于排查采光/辐射工作流问题。
descEn:
Launch a browser window that can be used to visualize the execution and logs of
any currently-running recipe.
_
Note that this component will only open the recipe visualizer in the default browser
and the page must be refreshed after starting a recipe run in order for the latest
recipe execution status to be visible.
_
Also note that the "Let [RECIPE NAME] Fly" task contains all of the information
about a given recipe run. Selecting "View Graph" for this task and then un-checking
"Hide Done" will allow one to see the full progress of the recipe.

in.d: Set to True to run the component and launch a browser window that visualizes recipe execution steps.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.

name: HB Faces by Attribute
desc: 按构造、朝向或自定义属性筛选面。
descEn:
Separate and group Honeybee Faces, Apertures, Doors and Shades by any attribute
that the objects possess.
_
This can be used to group faces by construction, modifier, etc.

in.d: An array of honeybee Rooms, Faces, Apertures, Doors or Shades to be separated by their attributes in the Rhino scene.

Text for the name of the Face attribute with which the Faces should be labeled. The Honeybee "Face Attributes" component lists all of the core attributes of the room. Also, each Honeybee extension (ie. Radiance, Energy) includes its own component that lists the Face attributes of that extension.

An optional value of the attribute that can be used to filter the output rooms. For example, if the input attribute is "Azimuth" a value for the orientation of the Face can be plugged in here (eg. "180" for south-facing) in order to get Faces with only this oreintation.

out.d: A list of values with one attribute value for each branch of the output hb_objs. hb_objs: A data tree of honeybee faces and sub-faces with each branc of the tree representing a different attribute value.

name: HB Faces by BC
desc: 按室外、地表、相邻等边界条件筛选面。
descEn:
Separate the faces/sub-faces of honeybee Rooms, Faces, Apertures, Doors or Shades
by boundary condition.

in.d: Honeybee Rooms, Faces, Apertures, Doors and/or Shades which will be separated based on boundary condition. This can also be an entire honeybee Model.

out.d: The objects with an Outdoors boundary condition.
The objects with a Surface (interior) boundary condition.
The objects with a Ground boundary condition.
The objects with an adiabatic (no heat flow) boundary condition.
All objects with a boundary condition other than the four above. All shades will also be added to this list.

name: HB Faces by Type
desc: 按墙、屋面、楼板等类型筛选面。
descEn:
Separate the faces/sub-faces of honeybee Rooms, Faces, Apertures, Doors, or Shades
by object and face type.

in.d: Honeybee Rooms, Faces, Apertures, Doors and/or Shades which will be separated based on object and face type. This can also be an entire honeybee Model.

out.d: The Walls with an Outdoors or Ground boundary condition.
The Walls with a Surface or Adiabatic boundary condition.
The RoofCeilings with an Outdoors or Ground boundary condition.
The RoofCeilings with a Surface or Adiabatic boundary condition.
The Floors with an Outdoors or Ground boundary condition.
The Floors with a Surface or Adiabatic boundary condition.
The AirWalls.
The Apertures with an Outdoors boundary condition.
The Apertures with a Surface boundary condition.
The Doors with an Outdoors boundary condition.
The Doors with a Surface boundary condition.
The Shades assigned to the outdoors of their parent objects. This also includes all orphaned shades of a model.
The Shades assigned to the indoors of their parent objects.

name: HB Rooms by Attribute
desc: 按楼层、朝向或自定义属性筛选并分组房间。
descEn:
Separate and group honeybee Rooms by any attribute that the room possesses.
_
This can be used to group rooms by program, whether rooms are conditioned, etc.

in.d: An array of honeybee Rooms or honeybee Models to be separated and grouped based on their attributes.

Text for the name of the Room attribute with which the Rooms should be labeled. The Honeybee "Room Attributes" component lists all of the core attributes of the room. Also, each Honeybee extension (ie. Radiance, Energy) includes its own component that lists the Room attributes of that extension.

An optional value of the attribute that can be used to filter the output rooms. For example, if the input attribute is "Program" a value for the name of a program can be plugged in here (eg. "2019::LargeOffice::OpenOffice") in order to get only the rooms that have this program assigned.

out.d: A list of values with one attribute value for each branch of the output rooms. rooms: A data tree of honeybee rooms with each branch of the tree representing a different attribute value.

name: HB Rooms by Floor Height
desc: 由平面轮廓与层高批量拉伸生成多层房间，是快速建模的常用入口。
descEn: Separate and group honeybee rooms with the same average floor height.

in.d: A list of honeybee Rooms or honeybee Models to be separated by floor height.

An optional float value to denote the minimum difference in floor heights that is considered meaningful. This can be used to ensure rooms like those representing stair landings are grouped with floors. If None, any difference in floor heights greater than the Rhino model tolerance will be considered meaningful.

out.d: A list of floor heights with one floor height for each branch of the output rooms.
A data tree of honeybee rooms with each branch of the tree representing a different floor height.

name: HB Rooms by Orientation
desc: 按朝向把大平面切分为多个房间，便于按朝向统计能耗。
descEn:
Separate and group honeybee rooms with the same average orientation of walls
with an Outdoors boundary condition.

in.d: A list of honeybee honeybee Rooms or honeybee Models to be separated by orientation.

An optional positive integer to set the number of orientation groups to use. For example, setting this to 4 will result in rooms being grouped by four orientations (North, East, South, West). If None, the maximum number of unique groups will be used.
A number between 0 and 360 to set the clockwise north direction in degrees. This can also be a vector to set the North. Default is 0.

out.d: A list of numbers between 0 and 360 with one orientation for each branch of the output perim_rooms. This will be a list of angle ranges if a value is input for n_groups_.
A data tree of honeybee rooms with each branch of the tree representing a different orientation.
A list of honeybee rooms with no identifiable orientation.

name: HB Dump Compressed Objects
desc: 把模型压缩为 hbjson.zip，显著减小文件体积。
descEn:
Dump any honeybee object to a compressed .pkl file. You can use "HB Load Compressed
Objects" component to load the objects from the file back into Grasshopper.
-
Honeybee objects include any Model, Room, Face, Aperture, Door, Shade, or
boundary condition object
-
It also includes any honeybee energy Material, Construction, ConstructionSet,
Schedule, Load, ProgramType, or Simulation object.

in.d: A Honeybee object (or list of Honeybee objects) to be written to a file.
A name for the file to which the honeybee objects will be written. (Default: 'unnamed').
An optional directory into which the honeybee objects will be written.  The default is set to the default simulation folder.
Set to "True" to save the honeybee objects to file.

out.d: Errors, warnings, etc.
The location of the file where the honeybee .pkl file is saved.

name: HB Dump gbXML
desc: 把模型导出为 gbXML 格式，供其他能耗软件读取。
descEn:
Dump a Honyebee Model to a gbXML file.
_
The gbXML format is a common open standard used to transfer energy model geometry
and (some) energy simulation properties from one simulation environment to another.
_
The forward translators within the OpenStudio SDK are used to export all Honeybee
model geometry and properties.

in.d: A Honeybee Model object to be written to a gbXML file.
A name for the file to which the honeybee objects will be written. If unspecified, it will be derived from the model identifier.
An optional directory into which the honeybee objects will be written.  The default is set to the default simulation folder.

A boolean to note whether all interior horizontal faces should be written with the InteriorFloor type instead of the combination of InteriorFloor and Ceiling that happens by default with OpenStudio gbXML serialization. (Default: False).

Boolean to note whether sub-faces (including Apertures and Doors) should be triangulated if they have more than 4 sides (True) or whether they should be left as they are (False). This triangulation is necessary when exporting directly to EnergyPlus since it cannot accept sub-faces with more than 4 vertices. However, it is not a general requirement of gbXML or all of the simulation engines that gbXML can import to/from. (Default: False).

Boolean to note whether space boundaries and shell geometry should be included in the exported gbXML vs. just the minimal required non-manifold geometry. Setting to True to include the full geometry will increase file size without adding much new infomration that doesn't already exist in the file. However, some gbXML interfaces need this geometry in order to properly represent and display room volumes. (Default: False).
Set to "True" to save the honeybee model to a gbXML file.

out.d: Errors, warnings, etc.
The location of the file where the honeybee JSON is saved.

name: HB Dump Objects
desc: 把 Honeybee 对象序列化为 hbjson，便于存档与跨软件交换。
descEn:
Dump any honeybee object to a JSON file. You can use "HB Load Objects" component
to load the objects from the file back into Grasshopper.
-
Honeybee objects include any honeybee energy Material, Construction,
ConstructionSet, Schedule, Load, ProgramType, or Simulation object.

in.d: A list of Honeybee objects to be written to a file.
A name for the file to which the honeybee objects will be written. (Default: 'unnamed').
An optional directory into which the honeybee objects will be written.  The default is set to the default simulation folder.
An optional positive integer to set the indentation used in the resulting JSON file.

Set to "True" to serialize the object in its abridged form. Abridged objects cannot be reserialized back to honeybee objects on their own but they are used throughout honeybee to minimize file size and unnecessary duplication.
Set to "True" to save the honeybee objects to file.

out.d: Errors, warnings, etc.
The location of the file where the honeybee JSON is saved.

name: HB Load Compressed Objects
desc: 从压缩的 hbjson.zip 文件读取模型。
descEn:
Load any honeybee object from a compressed .pkl or .hbpkl file.
-
Honeybee objects include any Model, Room, Face, Aperture, Door, Shade, or
boundary condition object.
-
It also includes any honeybee energy Material, Construction, ConstructionSet,
Schedule, Load, ProgramType, or Simulation object.

in.d: A file path to a .pkl or .hbpkl from which objects will be loaded back into Grasshopper.
Set to "True" to load the objects from the _hb_file.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
A list of honeybee objects that have been re-serialized from the input file.

name: HB Load gbXML OSM IDF
desc: 从 gbXML、OpenStudio 或 EnergyPlus 文件反读模型。
descEn:
Load a gbXML, OSM, or IDF file as a Honeybee Model.
_
The reverse translators within the OpenStudio SDK are used to import all geometry
and boundary conditions (including adjacencies) to a Honeybee format.
_
Note that, while all geometry will be imported, it is possible that not all of the
properties assigned to this geometry will be imported, particularly if a certain
property is not supported in the OpenStudio SDK. Honeybee will assign defaults
for missing properites.

in.d: A file path to a gbXML, OSM or IDF file from which a Honeybee Model will be loaded.
Set to True to have all energy properties reset to defaults upon import, meaning that only the geometry and boundary conditions are imported from the model file. (Default: False).
Set to "True" to load the Model from the input file.

out.d: A honeybee Model objects that has been re-serialized from the input file.

name: HB Load Objects
desc: 从 hbjson 文件读取 Honeybee 模型或对象。
descEn:
Load any honeybee object from a honeybee JSON file
-
Honeybee objects include any Model, Room, Face, Aperture, Door, Shade, or
boundary condition object.
-
It also includes any honeybee energy Material, Construction, ConstructionSet,
Schedule, Load, ProgramType, or Simulation object.

in.d: A file path to a honeybee JSON from which objects will be loaded back into Grasshopper. The objects in the file must be non-abridged in order to be loaded back correctly.
Set to "True" to load the objects from the _hb_file.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
A list of honeybee objects that have been re-serialized from the input file.

name: HB Object to String
desc: 把 Honeybee 对象序列化为字符串，便于存进 GH 参数或写入数据库。
descEn:
Serialize any honeybee object to a JSON text string. You can use "HB String to Object"
component to load the objects from the file back.
-
Honeybee objects include any honeybee energy Material, Construction,
ConstructionSet, Schedule, Load, ProgramType, or Simulation object.

in.d: A Honeybee object to be serialized to a string.

out.d: A text string that completely describes the honeybee object. This can be serialized back into a honeybee object using the "HB String to Object" coponent.

name: HB String to Object
desc: 把序列化字符串还原为 Honeybee 对象。
descEn:
Serialize any honeybee JSON text string back to a honeybee object.
-
Honeybee objects include any Model, Room, Face, Aperture, Door, Shade, or
boundary condition object.
-
It also includes any honeybee energy Material, Construction, ConstructionSet,
Schedule, Load, ProgramType, or Simulation object.

in.d: A text string that completely describes the honeybee object.

out.d: A Honeybee object serialized from the input string.

name: HB Update HBJSON
desc: 把旧版本 hbjson 文件升级到当前版本的数据结构。
descEn:
Upgrade a Model HBJSON file to the currently installed version of the schema.
_
This component can also upgrade to a specific version of the schema but it
cannot downgrade the schema version or change the version of any honeybee
object other than a Model.
_
A full list of honeybee-schema versions can be found on the honeybee-schema GitHub:
https://github.com/ladybug-tools/honeybee-schema/releases

in.d: A file path to a Model HBJSON which will be upgraded to the currently installed version of the Honeybee Model schema (or a specific version specified below).

Text to indicate the version to which the Model HBJSON will be updated (eg. 1.41.2). Versions must always consist of three integers separated by periods. If None, the Model HBJSON will be updated to the currently installed version of honeybee-schema.
A name for the file to which the honeybee objects will be written. By default, it will have the same name as the input file but with "UPDATED" appended to the file name.
An optional directory into which the updated file will be written.  The default is set to the default simulation folder.

Boolean to note whether the Honeybee Model should be validated and checked for errors after it has been updated. This includes basic properties like adjacency and duplicate identifier checks as well as geometry checks for planarity, room solidity, etc.
Set to "True" to update the Model HBJSON to the currently installed version.

out.d: Reports, errors, warnings, etc.
The file path to the updated HBJSON.

name: HB Validate Model
desc: 检查模型中的非平面面、开口重叠、未闭合体量等问题并给出修改建议。
descEn:
Get a validation report that contains a summary of all issues with the Model.
_
This includes basic properties like adjacency checks and all geometry checks.
Furthermore, all extension attributes for Energy and Radiance will be checked
to ensure that the model can be simulated correctly in these engines.

in.d: A Honeybee Model object to be validated. This can also be the file path to a Model HBJSON that will be validated.

Optional text for the name of the honeybee extension for which validation will occur. The value input here is case-insensitive such that "radiance" and "Radiance" will both result in the model being checked for validity with honeybee-radiance. This value can also be set to "Generic" in order to run checks for all installed extensions. Using "Generic" will run all except the most limiting of checks (like DOE2's lack of support for courtyards) with the goal of producing a model that is export-able to multiple engines (albeit with a little extra postprocessing for particularly limited engines). Some common honeybee extension names that can be input here if they are installed include  the following. (Default: Generic). * Radiance * EnergyPlus * OpenStudio * DesignBuilder * DOE2 * IES * IDAICE
Set to "True" to validate the the Model and get a report of all issues with the model.

out.d: A report summarizing any issues with the input _model. If anything is invalid about the input model, this component will give a warning and this report will contain information about the specific parts of the model that are invalid. Otherwise, this report will simply say that the input model is valid.

name: HB Check Versions
desc: 对比本机安装的 Ladybug Tools 各包版本与组件版本是否匹配。
descEn:
Check the versions of the engines that are being used by the honeybee plugin.
This is useful for verifying that everything has been installed correctly
and that the versions of the engines are as expected.
-

    Returns:
        lbt_gh: The version of Ladybug Tools for Grasshopper that is installed.
        python: The version of Python used for Ladybug Tools CLI calls.
        radiance: The version of Radiance used by Ladybug Tools (will be None if
            it is not installed).
        openstudio: The version of OpenStudio used by Ladybug Tools (will be None if
            it is not installed).
        energyplus: The version of EnergyPlus used by Ladybug Tools (will be None if
            it is not installed).

out.d: The version of Ladybug Tools for Grasshopper that is installed.
The version of Python used for Ladybug Tools CLI calls.
The version of Radiance used by Ladybug Tools (will be None if it is not installed).
The version of OpenStudio used by Ladybug Tools (will be None if it is not installed).
The version of EnergyPlus used by Ladybug Tools (will be None if it is not installed).

name: HB Color Face Attributes
desc: 按面的构造、边界条件等属性着色显示。
descEn:
Color Honeybee Faces, Apertures, Doors and Shades in the Rhino scene using
their attributes.
_
This can be used as a means to check that correct properties are assigned to
different faces.

in.d: An array of honeybee Rooms, Faces, Apertures, Doors or Shades to be colored with their attributes in the Rhino scene. This can also be an entire Model to be colored.

Text for the name of the attribute with which the faces or sub-faces should be labeled. The Honeybee "Face Attributes" component lists all of the core attributes of the room. Also, each Honeybee extension (ie. Radiance, Energy) includes its own component that lists the face and sub-face attributes of that extension.
An optional LegendParameter object to change the display of the colored faces and sub-faces (Default: None).

out.d: Meshes of the faces and sub-faces colored according to their attributes.
Geometry representing the legend for colored meshes.
A list of lines representing the outlines of the _hb_objs.
A list of values noting the attribute assigned to each face/sub-face.

A list of colors noting the color of each face/sub-face in the Rhino scene. This can be used in conjunction with the native Grasshopper "Custom Preview" component to create custom visualizations in the Rhino scene.

An object containing VisualizationSet arguments for drawing a detailed version of the ColorRoom in the Rhino scene. This can be connected to the "LB Preview Visualization Set" component to display this version of the visualization in Rhino.

name: HB Color Room Attributes
desc: 按房间的名称、楼层、热区等属性着色显示。
descEn:
Color Honeybee rooms in the Rhino scene using their attributes.
_
This can be used as a means to check that correct properties are assigned to
different Rooms.

in.d: An array of honeybee Rooms or honeybee Models to be colored with their attributes in the Rhino scene.

Text for the name of the Room attribute with which the Rooms should be labeled. The Honeybee "Room Attributes" component lists all of the core attributes of the room. Also, each Honeybee extension (ie. Radiance, Energy) includes its own component that lists the Room attributes of that extension.
An optional LegendParameter object to change the display of the colored rooms (Default: None).

out.d: Meshes of the room floors colored according to their attributes.
Geometry representing the legend for colored meshes.
A list of lines representing the outlines of the rooms.
A list of values that align with the input _rooms noting the attribute assigned to each room.

A list of colors that align with the input Rooms, noting the color of each Room in the Rhino scene. This can be used in conjunction with the native Grasshopper "Custom Preview" component and other honeybee visualization components (like "HB Visulaize Quick") to create custom visualizations in the Rhino scene.

An object containing VisualizationSet arguments for drawing a detailed version of the ColorRoom in the Rhino scene. This can be connected to the "LB Preview Visualization Set" component to display this version of the visualization in Rhino.

name: HB Config
desc: 设置 Honeybee 的默认容差、单位、库路径与模拟引擎路径。
descEn:
Check the local configuration of the engines and data sets used by the honeybee
plugin. This is useful for verifying that everything has been installed correctly
and that the engines are configured as expected.
-

    Returns:
        python_exe: The path to the Python executable to be used for Ladybug
            Tools CLI calls.
        py_lib_install: The path to where the Ladybug Tools Python packages
            are installed.
        rad_install: The path to Radiance installation folder if it exists.
        os_install: The path to OpenStudio installation folder if it exists.
        ep_install: The path to EnergyPlus installation folder if it exists.
        hb_os_gem: The path to the honeybee_openstudio_gem if it exists. This gem
            contains libraries and measures for translating between Honeybee
            JSON schema and OpenStudio Model schema (OSM).
        standards: The path to the library of standards if it exists. This library
            contains the default Modifiers, ModifierSets, Constructions,
            ConstructionSets, Schedules, and ProgramTypes. It can be extended
            by dropping IDF or Honeybee JOSN files into the appropriate sub-folder.
        asset_report: A report of all the assets that have been loaded from the
            standards library.
        default_sim: The path to the default simulation folder (where simulation
            files are written if not specified by the user.).

out.d: The path to the Python executable to be used for Ladybug Tools CLI calls.
The path to where the Ladybug Tools Python packages are installed.
The path to Radiance installation folder if it exists.
The path to OpenStudio installation folder if it exists.
The path to EnergyPlus installation folder if it exists.
The path to the honeybee_openstudio_gem if it exists. This gem contains libraries and measures for translating between Honeybee JSON schema and OpenStudio Model schema (OSM).

The path to the library of standards if it exists. This library contains the default Modifiers, ModifierSets, Constructions, ConstructionSets, Schedules, and ProgramTypes. It can be extended by dropping IDF or Honeybee JOSN files into the appropriate sub-folder.
A report of all the assets that have been loaded from the standards library.
The path to the default simulation folder (where simulation files are written if not specified by the user.).

name: HB Envelope Edges
desc: 提取模型外围护结构的边线，用于出图与线稿表达。
descEn:
Get the edges of a Model's envelope grouped based on the objects they adjoin.
_
The edges returned by this component will only exist along the exterior
envelope of the Model's rooms as defined by the contiguous volume across
all interior adjacencies. In this way, edges that adjoin two honeybee rooms
will only be represented once in the list (and not twice for the two rooms).
_
The lengths of the resulting edges are useful for evaluating thermal bridges
across the model.

in.d: A honeybee Model with rooms for which adjacencies have been solved.
Boolean to note whether edges falling between two coplanar Faces in the building envelope should be included in the result (False) or excluded from it (True). (Default: True).

The maximum difference that apertures or doors can be from one another for the edges to be considered a mullion rather than a frame. If None, all edges of apertures and doors will be considered frames rather than mullions.

out.d: A list of line segments for where exterior apertures meet their parent exterior wall or roof.
A list of line segments for where exterior apertures meet one another.
A list of line segments for where exterior doors meet their parent exterior wall or roof.
A list of line segments for where exterior doors meet one another.

A list of line segments where roofs meet exterior walls (or floors). Note that both the roof Face and the wall/floor Face must be next to one another in the model's outer envelope and have outdoor boundary conditions for the edge to show up in this list.

A list of line segments where ground floor slabs meet exterior walls or roofs. Note that the floor Face must have a ground boundary condition and the wall or roof Face must have an outdoor boundary condition for the edge between the two Faces to show up in this list.

A list of line segments where exposed floors meet exterior walls. Note that both the wall Face and the floor Face must be next to one another in the model's outer envelope and have outdoor boundary conditions for the edge to show up in this list.

A list of line segments where exterior walls meet one another. Note that both wall Faces must be next to one another in the model's outer envelope and have outdoor boundary conditions for the edge to show up in this list.

A list of line segments where exterior roofs meet one another. Note that both roof Faces must be next to one another in the model's outer envelope and have outdoor boundary conditions for the edge to show up in this list.

A list of line segments where exposed floors meet one another. Note that both floor Faces must be next to one another in the model's outer envelope and have outdoor boundary conditions for the edge to show up in this list.

A list of line segments where underground Faces meet one another. Note that both Faces must be next to one another in the model's outer envelope and have ground boundary conditions for the edge to show up in this list.

name: HB Face Attributes
desc: 提供面可查看/可设置属性的预设值列表。

out.d: List of preset values to choose from.

name: HB Geometry Properties
desc: 统计模型的面积、体积、窗墙比等几何指标。
descEn: Get geometry properties of honeybee Rooms or a honeybee Model.

in.d: A list of honeybee Rooms for which or geometry properties will be output. This can also be an entire honeybee Model.

out.d: A number for the total area of walls in the honeybee rooms with an Outdoors boundary condition (in Rhino model units).
A number for the total area of windows in the honeybee rooms with an Outdoors boundary condition (in Rhino model units).
A number for the volume of the honeybee rooms (in Rhino model units).

A number for the floor area  of the honeybee rooms (in Rhino model units). When a Model is connected, the floor area will exclude plenums and other Rooms with that have a True exclude_floor_area property.

A number for the floor area of the Room accounting for the thickness of EnergyPlus wall constructions. (in Rhino model units). When a Model is connected, the floor area will exclude plenums and other Rooms with that have a True exclude_floor_area property.

name: HB Label Faces
desc: 在视图中为每个面添加类型或属性文字标注。
descEn:
Lablel Honeybee faces and sub-faces with their attributes in the Rhino scene.
_
This can be used as a means to check that correct properties are assigned to
different faces and sub-faces.

in.d: Honeybee Faces, Rooms or a Model to be labeled with their attributes in the Rhino scene.

Text for the name of the attribute with which the faces or sub-faces should be labeled. The Honeybee "Face Attributes" component lists all of the core attributes of the room. Also, each Honeybee extension (ie. Radiance, Energy) includes its own component that lists the face and sub-face attributes of that extension. Default: "name".
An optional number for the height of the text in the Rhino scene.  The default is auto-calculated based on the dimensions of the input geometry.
An optional name of a font in which the labels will display. This must be a font that is installed on this machine in order to work correctly. Default: "Arial".

out.d: The text with which each of the faces or sub-faces are labeled.
The base point for each of the text labels.
The text objects that are displaying within the Rhino scene.
A list of curves representing the outlines of the faces or sub-faces. This is useful for understanding which geometry elements each label corresponds to.

name: HB Label Rooms
desc: 在视图中为每个房间添加名称或属性文字标注。
descEn:
Lablel Honeybee rooms with their attributes in the Rhino scene.
_
This can be used as a means to check that correct properties are assigned to
different Rooms.

in.d: An array of honeybee Rooms or honeybee Models to be labeled with their attributes in the Rhinoscene.

Text for the name of the Room attribute with which the Rooms should be labeled. The Honeybee "Room Attributes" component lists all of the core attributes of the room. Also, each Honeybee extension (ie. Radiance, Energy) includes its own component that lists the Room attributes of that extension. Default: "name".
An optional number for the height of the text in the Rhino scene.  The default is auto-calculated based on the dimensions of the input geometry.
An optional name of a font in which the labels will display. This must be a font that is installed on this machine in order to work correctly. Default: "Arial".

out.d: The text with which each of the rooms are labeled.
The base planes for each of the text labels.
The text objects that are displaying within the Rhino scene.
A list of curves representing the outlines of the rooms. This is useful for understanding which geometry elements each label corresponds to.

name: HB Room Attributes
desc: 提供房间可查看/可设置属性的预设值列表。

out.d: List of preset values to choose from.

name: HB Visualize All
desc: 同时显示房间、窗洞与遮阳，得到完整的建筑模型外观。
descEn:
Preview any Honeybee geometry object within the Rhino scene, including all
sub-faces and assigned shades.

in.d: A Honeybee Model, Room, Face, Shade, Aperture, or Door to be previewed in the Rhino scene.

out.d: The Rhino version of the Honeybee geometry object, which will be visible in the Rhino scene.

name: HB Visualize by BC
desc: 按边界条件为模型着色，检查内外墙与相邻关系是否合理。
descEn: Visualize room geometry in the Rhino scene organized by boundary condition.

in.d: A Honeybee Model, Room, Face, Aperture, Door or Shade to be previewed in the Rhino scene based on boundary condition.

out.d: Rhino geometry for the objects with an Outdoors boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for the objects with a Surface (interior) boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for the objects with a Ground boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for the objects with an adiabatic (no heat flow) boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for all objects with a boundary condition other than the four above. All shade geometry will also be added to this list.
A list of lines representing the outlines of the rooms.

name: HB Visualize by Type
desc: 按墙、屋面、楼板、窗等类型为模型着色，快速检查建模是否正确。
descEn: Visualize room geometry in the Rhino scene organized by object and face type.

in.d: A Honeybee Model, Room, Face, Aperture, Door or Shade to be previewed in the Rhino scene based on type.

out.d: Rhino geometry for the Walls with an Outdoors or Ground boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for the Walls with a Surface or Adiabatic boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for the RoofCeilings with an Outdoors or Ground boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for the RoofCeilings with a Surface or Adiabatic boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for the Floors with an Outdoors or Ground boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for the Floors with a Surface or Adiabatic boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for the AirWalls.
Rhino geometry for the Apertures with an Outdoors boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for the Apertures with a Surface boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for the Doors with an Outdoors boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for the Doors with a Surface boundary condition.
Rhino geometry for the Shades assigned to the outdoors of their parent objects. This also includes all orphaned shades of a model.
Rhino geometry for the Shades assigned to the indoors of their parent objects.
A list of lines representing the outlines of the rooms.

name: HB Visualize Normals
desc: 显示各面的法线方向，检查面朝向是否朝外。
descEn:
Get aligned points and vectors to preview the normal direction of any Honeybee
geometry object the Rhino scene, including all sub-faces and assigned shades.

in.d: A Honeybee Model, Room, Face, Shade, Aperture, or Door for which points and vectors will be output in the Rhino scene to show the object's orientation.

out.d: Points that lie at the center of each surface of the connected _hb_objs. These should be connected to the "Anchor" input of a native Grasshopper "Vector Display" component.
Normal vectors for each surface of the connected _hb_objs. These should be connected to the "Vector" input of a native Grasshopper "Vector Display" component.

name: HB Visualize Quick
desc: 用简化方式快速显示模型体量，兼顾速度与可读性。
descEn:
Quickly preview any Honeybee geometry object within the Rhino scene.
_
Sub-faces and assigned shades will not be included in the output, allowing for
a faster preview of large lists of objects but without the ability to check the
assignment of child objects.

in.d: A Honeybee Model, Room, Face, Shade, Aperture, or Door to be previewed in the Rhino scene.

out.d: The Rhino version of the Honeybee geometry object, which will be visible in the Rhino scene.

name: HB Visualize Wireframe
desc: 以线框方式显示模型，便于在复杂场景中查看结构。
descEn:
Quickly preview any Honeybee geometry object as a wire frame within the Rhino
scene, including all sub-faces and assigned shades.

in.d: A Honeybee Model, Room, Face, Shade, Aperture, or Door to be previewed as a wire frame in the Rhino scene.

out.d: The Rhino wireframe version of the Honeybee geometry object, which will be visible in the Rhino scene.

name: HB Adiabatic by Type
desc: 把指定类型的面设为绝热边界，用于简化相邻空间。
descEn: Make boundary conditions of Rooms or Faces adiabatic by face type.

in.d: Honeybee Faces or Rooms to which adiabatic boundary conditions will be assigned.

If True, all exterior walls of the input Rooms or Faces will be set to adiabatic. This can also be a list of boolean values and different adiabatic values will be assigned based on the cardinal direction, starting with north and moving clockwise.
If True, all exterior roofs of the input Rooms or Faces will be set to adiabatic.
If True, all exposed floors of the input Rooms or Faces will be set to adiabatic.
If True, all interior walls of the input Rooms or Faces will be set to adiabatic.
If True, all interior floors and ceilings of the input Rooms or Faces will be set to adiabatic.

out.d: The input honeybee objects with their boundary conditions edited.

name: HB Blend ProgramTypes
desc: 按面积比例把多个用途模板混合为一个新模板。
descEn:
Create a ProgramType object by blending other ProgramTypes together using a weighted
average based on program ratios.

in.d: Text to set the name for the ProgramType and to be incorporated into a unique ProgramType identifier.
A list of ProgramType objects that will be averaged together to make a new ProgramType.

A list of fractional numbers with the same length as the input programs that sum to 1. These will be used to weight each of the ProgramType objects in the resulting average. If None, the input program objects will be weighted equally. Default: None.

out.d: A ProgramType object that's a weighted average between the input _programs.

name: HB Building Programs
desc: 提供用途模板库中的建筑类型可选值。

out.d: List of preset values to choose from.

name: HB Building Vintages
desc: 提供建筑年代（影响构造与规范）可选值。

out.d: List of preset values to choose from.

name: HB Climate Zones
desc: 提供 ASHRAE 气候区可选值。

out.d: List of preset values to choose from.

name: HB Construction Set by Climate
desc: 按气候区自动匹配符合当地规范的构造集。
descEn:
Get a ConstructionSet from the standards library using a climate zone, building
vintage and construction type.

in.d: An integer between 1 and 8 for the ASHRAE climate zone in which the building is located. ASHRAE climate zones exist for all locations on Earth and can typically be looked up online or within the .stat file that downloads next to the .epw file. The climate zone is used to determine the amount of code-recommended insulation and solar heat gain protection for the construction set. The Honeybee "Climate Zones" component lists all of the climate zones supported by the library.

Text for the building vintage to search (eg. "2019", "pre_1980", etc.). The Honeybee "Building Vintages" component lists all of the vintages available in the library. Default: "2019" (for ASHRAE 90.1 2019). Note that vintages are often called "templates" within the OpenStudio standards gem and so this property effective maps to the standards gem "template".

Text for the construction type of the set. (eg. "SteelFramed", "WoodFramed", "Mass", "Metal Building"). The Honeybee "Construction Types" component lists all of the construction types available in the library. Default: "SteelFramed".

out.d: A ConstructionSet identifier that can be applied to Honeybee Rooms.

name: HB Construction Types
desc: 提供构造集库中的建筑类型（轻质、重质、木结构等）可选值。

out.d: List of preset values to choose from.
